summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the uploads directory. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path escapes the uploads directory. Any client can read any file the server process can read. This includes secrets, config files and source code. Serve the file with flask.send_from_directory, which rejects paths outside the base directory. Alternatively resolve the path and verify it stays under UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.fix: Serve the file with flask.send_from_directory, which rejects paths outside the base directory. Alternatively resolve the path and verify it stays under UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.title: Interactive debugger exposed on all interfaces
findings.description: The change turns on debug mode and switches the bind address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The Werkzeug debugger is now reachable from the network. Anyone on the network who triggers an error can run arbitrary code through the debugger console. The download endpoint's 404 path and other errors make this easy. Keep the bind address at 127.0.0.1 and turn debug off by default. Read both from environment configuration if needed.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.description: The change adds the download handler with a 404 branch and a file-serving branch. No test exercises either branch. Regressions in path handling, including traversal protection, will go unnoticed. Add tests for an existing file, a missing file and a traversal attempt such as ../etc/passwd.
